description: What the public tree leaves out. Pro code is found by path (ADR 0019): files named pro_* (Go code and its tests, test data) or inside a pro/ directory, and frontend/src/pro/. Patterns use * (inside one path segment), ** (any depth) and a trailing / for a directory. Everything else (the Go feature registry, the generated entitlementMatrix.ts, the Query Stats/Schema Rollback/PII upsell copy) ships as-is on purpose: a plan knowing what it doesn't include, and showing an upgrade prompt for it, is core behavior, not a Pro secret.
